title: duma coccoloboides
intro: Duma coccoloboides, commonly known as the Coccoloba plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polygonaceae. This plant is valued for its various uses, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Duma coccoloboides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Duma coccoloboides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
